observedDateConvention: UTC date of the producing run or upload; audit and publication dates are separate.
context: Observations from one mobile application's CI optimization work. Detailed source mapping is retained privately by the coordinating owners.

scope.comparisonWarning: These experiments used different sources, recipes, environments and dates. Do not sum their percentages or extrapolate them to monthly spend.

measurements.operation: Complete signed Android build jobs with subsequent fresh package smoke acceptance
limits: Same application source, but SDK cache warmth and workflow recipe commits differed.
Allocated core-minutes use job duration, not independently measured billable VM lifetime.
Two cores passed but paging made it a poor default for this workload.
This does not establish a CPU-only causal effect, provider price comparison or invoice saving.

measurements.operation: Whole Gradle Debug x86_64 command in independent local checkouts constrained to two CPUs
limits: One local pair, not hosted complete-job or signed-release performance.
Selected native trees and APK entries matched; this is not whole-APK byte equality.
Compiler seed was copied explicitly and produced no hits. Attribute the improvement to native Gradle task reuse, not compiler hits.
No device/runtime acceptance or monthly savings claim follows from this pair.

measurements.operation: Hosted Debug compile job, trusted-main compatible APK restored by a PR reader
limits: One before/after hosted reader pair; recipe, cache warmth and VM variability are not fully controlled.
Compile-job reduction excludes the separate runtime job and added main publication cost.
The two-reader example compares incremental job wall work under assumed comparable conditions, not billed money or critical-path latency.
Provider authorization settings were not independently verified by successful lookup and namespace separation.
Debug x86_64 evidence does not qualify signed ARM builds or monthly net savings.

measurements.operation: Observed ZIP containers from separate 124,108,800-byte required-handoff generations, stored versus compression level 1
limits: Both source TARs were 124,108,800 bytes, but their digests differed; this was not an identical-payload compression control.
These are ZIP container sizes, not the original uncompressed TAR size or a later package generation.
Equal rounded upload step duration does not prove equal precise transfer time.
The byte reduction is not a measured time reduction or bandwidth-cost saving.

measurements.operation: Observed Check runs after reducing repeated and selected work
limits: Summed job duration and elapsed run critical path are different quantities.
Moving browser coverage to main changes detection timing and pre-merge coverage; it is not proof of identical pre-merge correctness.
These observations are not a controlled fixed-source trial or monthly spend estimate.

measurements.operation: Observed Linux standard QA controller job for RunCloud: fresh run versus accepted compatible result reuse
limits: An exact compatible accepted result with an age bound was reused; QA itself was not made faster.
This does not qualify full automated Contacts XCTest, dense contacts, another appearance or carrier audio.
Different observed runs and recipes; not an additive speedup with other iOS preparation or compiler experiments.
